jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Age

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "integer",
  "minimum": 1,
  "maximum": 150
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/agepkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestAge_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`42`)
	var a Age
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &a); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if a != 42 {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal = %d, want 42", int(a))
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != "42" {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want 42", out)
	}
}

// minimum / maximum are validation concerns enforced by
// jsonschema.Validate, not the generated unmarshaler. Out-of-range
// values decode structurally without error.
func TestAge_NoRangeValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, in := range []string{`0`, `200`} {
		var a Age
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &a); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Unmarshal(%s): %v", in, err)
		}
	}
}
